title: CMT® Charter (Chartered Market Technician)
source: CMT Association Curriculum & Body of Knowledge
summary: The definitive credential for technical analysis, quantitative trading models, behavioral economics, and market microstructure across 3 progressive exam levels and 3 years experience. Grants US FINRA Series 86 waiver.

standard.name: Standard Market Technician Track
standard.blurb: Pass CMT Levels I, II, and III, document 3 years of market analysis experience, and adhere to the Code of Ethics.

stages.title: Stage 1: CMT Level I – Terminology & Fundamental Concepts
stages.subtitle: Basic charting techniques, price action, and trend definitions (132 MCQs | 2 Hours)

nodes.name: Level I Curriculum: Technical Analysis Terminology
nodes.description: Basic terminology, chart construction (candlestick, bar, point-and-figure), support/resistance, trend analysis, classical chart patterns, moving averages, volume, and basic indicators.
topics: Theory and History of Technical Analysis & Dow Theory
Chart Construction: Candlesticks, Line, Bar, Point and Figure
Trend Analysis, Support/Resistance & Classical Reversal/Continuation Patterns
Moving Averages, Price Oscillators & Volume Indicators
CMT Association Code of Ethics & Standards of Professional Conduct

nodes.name: CMT Level I Examination Sitting
nodes.description: Computer-based testing evaluating definitions, terminology, and foundational chart analysis rules.

stages.title: Stage 2: CMT Level II – Theory & Analysis
stages.subtitle: Advanced indicators, volatility models, and behavioral macro (170 MCQs | 4 Hours)

nodes.name: Level II Curriculum: Quantitative & Volatility Models
nodes.description: Statistical concepts in technical analysis, trend-following indicators, volatility indicators (Bollinger Bands, ATR), intermarket analysis, market breadth, and behavioral finance.
topics: Statistical Measures, Regression & Correlation in Market Analysis
Advanced Oscillators (RSI, Stochastics, MACD) & Divergence Analysis
Volatility Indicators, Bands & Options Volatility Surface Intuition
Intermarket Analysis: Equities, Bonds, Currencies, and Commodities Relationships
Behavioral Economics: Cognitive Biases & Market Sentiment Metrics

nodes.name: CMT Level II Examination Sitting
nodes.description: Computer-based examination testing applied technical theory, quantitative indicators, and intermarket analysis.

stages.title: Stage 3: CMT Level III – Behavioral Finance & Portfolio Application
stages.subtitle: Synthesis, system design, and constructed response essays (4 Hours)

nodes.name: Level III Curriculum: Trading System Design & Risk
nodes.description: Designing algorithmic and systematic trading systems, backtesting protocols, money management rules, position sizing, behavioral finance overlays, and portfolio risk management.
topics: Trading System Architecture & Backtesting Parameter Optimization
Money Management, Position Sizing (Kelly Criterion, Fixed Fraction) & Risk Control
Behavioral Macro Analysis & Market Timing Strategies
Professional Ethics and Fiduciary Responsibilities in Market Research

nodes.name: CMT Level III Examination Sitting
nodes.description: Comprehensive examination combining constructed response essay scenarios and item sets requiring integration of trading systems, risk management, and market research.

stages.title: Stage 4: Experience & Member Induction
stages.subtitle: 3 Years Market Analysis Experience + Series 86 Waiver

nodes.name: 3 Years Professional Market Analysis Experience
nodes.description: Demonstrate at least 3 years of acceptable professional work experience in market analysis, trading, portfolio management, or investment research.

nodes.name: CMT Charter Conferred & FINRA Series 86 Waiver
nodes.description: Formal award of the Chartered Market Technician (CMT®) credential. Charterholders qualify for an exemption from the FINRA Series 86 examination in the United States.
topics: US FINRA Series 86 Research Analyst Exam Exemption
